I can’t take that picture after all…
Maybe it’s because of what DAK told me, or maybe Admin convinced me to his cause during our talk, but I don’t think that reporting him to authorities is the right thing to do.
I’m sorry Big Daddy, but this time I’m gonna listen to my gut.
I hope my decision will not impact our friendship, but so far Big Daddy was always understanding.
You: Sorry Admin. I can’t help you after all.
Admin: Huh? Why? Did I say something wrong?
You: No, I just changed my mind. I still think your cause is right, but I just don’t think that I’m the right person for the job.
Admin: Well, that’s a pity, but I will trust your judgment on this.
Admin: Nevertheless, feel free to stay on our blog and support us in any way you are comfortable with.
You: No problem.
You: Once again, I’m sorry for wasting your time.
Admin: Don’t worry about it, although people from the blog might give you a hard time over this. I unnecessarily raised their expectations.
You: Don’t worry about it.
